output.family_rule: same isometric camera, object scale, margin, top-right soft light, semi-matte material, shadow direction, and muted-saturated palette

generation_provider.model_resolution_rule: Use an authenticated Codex model session that exposes image_gen.imagegen; do not invent a model ID.
generation_provider.codex_cli_capability_note: Codex CLI exposes image_gen.imagegen in the authenticated session. The CLI --image flag is input attachment only; invoke image_gen.imagegen through codex exec and save the returned image as PNG.
generation_provider.codex_command_template: codex exec --sandbox workspace-write --cd ${WORKSPACE} -- 'Use image_gen.imagegen with {prompt: PROMPT, transparent_background: false}; save the returned PNG to OUTPUT_PATH; verify dimensions and bytes.'
generation_provider.never_claim: Do not claim generated assets until a real PNG is downloaded, file-identified, dimension-checked, and visually reviewed.

style_contract.composition: 1 central dominant object plus 1-3 supporting objects; 2-4 objects total; layered diagonal or symmetrical depth
style_contract.lighting: soft ambient light from subtle top-right/front-top; gentle shadows below and behind; mild edge illumination
style_contract.material: semi-matte to satin; smooth stylized-natural surfaces; light tactile variation; no hyper-realistic noise
style_contract.render: high-resolution Octane-style 3D; crisp edges; no outlines; clean readable shapes
style_contract.palette: naturalistic with slight saturation boost; harmonious muted tones; distinct colors per object
style_contract.negative: flat vector, 2D clipart, line icon, outline, CSS shadow, UI card, badge, border, frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, QR code, people, hands, faces, cropped object, busy background, checkerboard, transparent background

batch_prompt: Generate a complete cohesive family of exactly eight separate premium isometric 3D service icons in one generation task. Return eight individually separable square icon artworks, not one merged scene, not a contact sheet, and not a UI layout. Every icon must use the exact same 1:1 canvas, camera angle, object scale, safe margin, lighting direction, material finish, shadow softness, and visual language. Use a pure flat white #FFFFFF background for every icon. Icon 1: Travel eSIM — central modern smartphone with a simple abstract globe-and-signal symbol, plus a small blank passport and rounded location pin. Icon 2: Travel Activities and Attractions — central bright camping tent, plus a small campfire, rolled sleeping bag, and tiny mountain sign with no text. Icon 3: Transportation — central generic compact yellow taxi, plus a small blank road sign and compact suitcase. Icon 4: Open Trip — central folded travel map with raised compass, plus a route location pin and compact airplane model. Icon 5: Baggage — central premium orange hard-shell rolling suitcase, plus a blank luggage tag and folded travel strap. Icon 6: Personal Shopper — central stylish reusable shopping bag, plus a small gift box and blank receipt with abstract lines only. Icon 7: Visa Assistance — central closed deep-blue passport with a subtle gold globe symbol and no text, plus a blank document sheet and round approval seal without letters. Icon 8: Travel Insurance — central rounded teal protective shield, plus a small airplane silhouette and compact medical cross badge without text. Each icon must contain only 2–4 readable objects, with one central dominant object and supporting objects arranged symmetrically or diagonally with layered depth and slight elevation. Use soft ambient light from the upper-right/front-top, gentle shadows below and behind objects, mild edge illumination, semi-matte to satin surfaces, smooth stylized-natural textures, naturalistic colors with a slight saturation boost, harmonious muted tones, distinct colors per object, high-resolution Octane-style 3D rendering, crisp edges, no outlines, no line art, premium friendly clean travel-app style, readable at 24px and 48px. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, QR code, UI card, badge text, border, frame, people, hands, faces, cropped objects, cut-off shadows, clutter, flat vector style, 2D clipart, checkerboard, transparency, colored background, gradient background, or inconsistent perspective. Preserve clear separation between the eight icons and provide each icon as an individually exportable 1024x1024 PNG with pure white background.
prompt_template: Create a single premium isometric 3D icon for {{concept}}. The central object is {{central_object}}. Add only these supporting objects: {{supporting_objects}}. Use 2-4 readable objects total, a 1:1 square canvas, generous margins, a consistent isometric camera, and uniform object scale across the family. Layer the objects diagonally or symmetrically to create real spatial depth and slight elevation. Use soft ambient light from the upper-right/front-top, gentle shadows below and behind, mild edge illumination, semi-matte to satin materials, smooth stylized-natural surfaces, naturalistic colors with a slight saturation boost, harmonious muted contrast, distinct colors per object, high-resolution Octane-style 3D rendering, crisp edges with no outlines, pure flat white #FFFFFF background, premium friendly clean lifestyle/service tone. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, QR code, UI card, border, frame, people, hands, faces, cropped objects, or busy background.
